title: Overcharge Interest on Repeat Over-Billing — Commercial Natural Gas Supply Swing Excess Credits
content:
**1. When interest is due.** Overcharge interest is due on a Commercial Natural Gas Supply swing excess rebill credit where the agreement has been over-billed before:

- when two or more rebill credit lines were posted on the agreement later than the same calendar day twenty-four months before the correction date, the monthly interest rate is 1.00 percent (0.0100);
- when exactly one was, the monthly interest rate is 0.50 percent (0.0050);
- when none was, no overcharge interest is due.

**2. The interest amount.** The overcharge interest is the over-billed amount multiplied by the monthly interest rate and by the months of overcharge interest, rounded half up to the cent. It is worked on the over-billed amount itself and is added to it once.

## Rate by correction history

| Rebill credit lines posted on the agreement in the twenty-four-month window | Monthly interest rate |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 1.00 percent |
| Exactly 1 | 0.50 percent |
| None | No overcharge interest |

The window is counted back from the correction date: for a correction dated 2025-09-15, a rebill credit line posted on 2023-09-16 or later counts, and one posted on 2023-09-15 does not.

## Worked amounts (hypothetical over-billed amounts and months)

| Over-billed amount | Monthly rate | Months of overcharge interest | Overcharge interest |
|---|---|---|---|
| $120.00 | 1.00 percent | 5 | $120.00 multiplied by 0.0100 and by 5, that is $6.00 |
| $37.45 | 0.50 percent | 7 | $37.45 multiplied by 0.0050 and by 7, that is $1.31075, rounded to $1.31 |
| $80.00 | None | Any | $0.00 |
